# Gestalt & Visual Perception

## GES-01 — Law of Proximity

- **Axiom:** Objects positioned close to one another are perceived as a unified conceptual group.
- **Apply when:** Form labels look attached to the wrong input, or unrelated actions read as one group because spacing is uniform.
- **Check:**
  - Place labels closer to their own input than to the preceding field (4px vs 24px).
  - Keep spacing inside a card tighter (8-12px) than spacing between cards (24-32px).
  - Group a primary action with its explanatory copy inside one layout cluster.
- **Instead of:** A form uses equal 16px margins everywhere, so each input visually attaches to the label below it.
- **Do:** Use 4px from label to input and 24px from the input container to the next field label.
- **Source:** Max Wertheimer (1923), *Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II*.
